changes.title: Arcana Spirit Form preview
changes.text: Known equipped Arcana rings now show Spirit Form's effect when the normal ring bonus is zero, matching actual enchantment and glyph power.

changes.title: Arcana fallback regression coverage
changes.text: Added checks for Spirit Form, temporary ring boosts, unidentified rings and weapon/armor preview layout without consuming gameplay randomness.

changes.title: Verified build records
changes.text: Recorded TEST102's verified delivery and TEST103's exact changes and checks.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I corrected an Arcana preview that missed Spirit Form's existing fallback. The displayed increase now matches the actual effect without changing gameplay.
